## Summary
- [ ] Feature added / bug fixed / documentation updated: ...

## Scope and compatibility
- Affected modules:
- Public API, data format, or behavior changes:
- Migration / rollback notes:

## Verified limitation and mitigation
- Observed limitation:
- Implemented mitigation (link to code/tests):
- User-visible impact and evidence:
- [ ] No defect or unsupported capability is presented as a delivered feature.

## UI / documentation
- [ ] README updated to reflect current implementation.
- [ ] GUI screenshots or wireframes added under `docs/gui/` when applicable.
- [ ] Ukrainian / English / Russian documentation aligned where maintained.
- [ ] Commands, links, badges, and status claims verified.

## Validation
- [ ] Relevant unit / integration / platform tests pass.
- [ ] Lint, formatting, and documentation checks pass.
- [ ] Coverage reported accurately (baseline and changed scope; no fabricated percentage).
- [ ] Accessibility and `prefers-reduced-motion` checked for UI changes.
- [ ] Security, privacy, and failure paths considered.

## Review and release
- [ ] At least two independent approvals obtained where enforced by repository policy.
- [ ] All required CI checks pass.
- [ ] Changelog / release notes updated when user-visible behavior changes.
